services.headline: Our Civil Engineering Services
services.description: We provide comprehensive civil engineering support for infrastructure projects of all scales.

items.title: Highway Surveys
items.description: Initial alignment and route planning with precision GNSS.

items.title: As-Built Surveys

items.title: Volumetric Surveys
items.description: 3D modeling and volume computations for stockpiles.

items.title: BIM & Digital Twins
items.description: Integrating spatial data into your BIM workflows.

items.title: Indoor Mapping

process.headline: Engineering Survey Process
process.description: Our systematic approach ensures accuracy, efficiency, and reliable deliverables for every civil engineering project.

items.title: Reconnaissance & Planning
items.description: Initial site assessment and mission design using RTK GNSS and SmartGrid survey frameworks.

items.title: Ground Control Setup
items.description: Deployment of marked GCPs and total station validation to anchor aerial data in real-world coordinates.

items.title: Drone Flight & Data Acquisition
items.description: RTK-enabled drones execute flight plans to capture imagery and topographic data with centimeter accuracy.

items.title: Photogrammetry Processing
items.description: SmartGrid software processes imagery into orthomosaics, DSMs, and 3D point clouds for engineering models.

items.title: Ground Verification
items.description: Total station and rover cross-checks are performed to verify aerial accuracy and validate deliverables.

items.title: Final Output Delivery
items.description: We compile CAD drawings, contour maps, volume analyses, and BIM-ready geospatial layers for site integration.

deliverables.headline: Engineering Deliverables
deliverables.description: Accurate outputs for planning and engineering decisions.
